notes.title: ODINFALL Update 0.6.0 is now LIVE | New character, Achievements, Looping mode!
notes.content:
Vikings, it’s here! 
The biggest [b]ODINFALL[/b] update yet! [b]Patch 0.6.0[/b] is now available on the [b]main branch[/b].

We’ve been working hard on bringing major new features and improvements to your post-apocalyptic playground, and today we’re thrilled to share them with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/21ff9c1b1df1a55da23077fb736e872de5b7c5bc.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Highlights[/h2]

[h3]New Looping Mode[/h3]
Replacing the Infinite Mode, Looping introduces a new system of difficulty scaling after defeating the final boss of the map you're on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/ad4f2a73be04ef1e9a062be489aefce9385e1f2c.gif[/img]

[h3]New Playable Character[/h3]
Meet Trulls, the Trapper!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/796bcea0b60f3ea813ff17c1e88e9478c86502e7.gif[/img]

[h3]Difficulty Settings[/h3]
Tailor the challenge to your playstyle with new customizable difficulty options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/a74502adfa947fa898c6f56f24b430f06ad40af1.gif[/img]

[h3]New Weapons & Mods[/h3]
Expand your arsenal with powerful new tools of destruction and strategic upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/0f6d197edd7aff3e4bc4e49a5943278db4f9e4e4.gif[/img]

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]
Unlock and track your progress with official Steam achievements!

As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts, join the conversation over on our Discord. :D

See you in the Loop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/32ca599f21f9f86421f6dc0172860457a3a51df9.png[/img]

[h2]Patch 0.6.0 Notes[/h2]
[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
Added: Steam achievements,
Added: automatic item scrapping,
Added: EASY difficulty setting. Odinfall veterans are recommended to switch to NORMAL right away,
Added: Difficulty setting terminal. Read the differences between difficulties,
Added: Looping after killing bosses,
Removed: Infinite area (replaced by Looping),
[h3]CHARACTERS[/h3]
Added: Trulls the Trapper,
Added: Trulls the Trapper Valhallan Order Files,
[h3]WEAPONS[/h3]
Added: Pike,
Added: Scythe,
Added: Air Pistol,
Added: Air Rifle,
Added: Super Pistol,
Added: Pop Pack,
Added: Bouncer Ballista,

[b]Arbalest[/b]
Arbalest renamed to Ballista,

[h3]MODS[/h3]
Added: Slow Barrage,
Added: Carbon Fibre,
Added: Bayonette

notes.title: ODINFALL Patch 0.5.7 is Now on the Experimental Branch! | TWITCH INTEGRATION
notes.content:
Vikings, it’s time to test something special!

[b]Patch 0.5.7[/b] is now [b]live[/b] on the [b]Experimental Branch![/b] 

This update brings [b]new weapons[/b], [b]gameplay improvements[/b], and a huge new feature: [b]Twitch Integration[/b]!

Want your chat to shape your run? Then this one’s for you.
([i]Full patch notes below[/i])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/82624138a710f4f07f6e3f5e8431aa5fe6af0638.png[/img]
[h1]Twitch Integration - How It Works[/h1]
[h2]Enabling Twitch Integration[/h2]
[olist][*] Opt into the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2154240/announcements/detail/512953841353752651]Experimental Branch[/url] ([i]more info on this below[/i]).
[*] Select the [b]"Twitch"[/b] option in the [b]settings[/b].
[*] [b]Log into your Twitch account[/b] to connect it to your game.
[*] [b]Hit play[/b], start the stream and you're [b]ready to go![/b][/olist]
[h2]How It Works[/h2]
When [b]entering a new node[/b], a [b]Twitch poll[/b] will begin.
[h3]Poll A: Weapon vs Weapon ([i]75% chance[/i])[/h3] 
[b]Viewers vote on 2 weapons[/b]; [b]winning weapon[/b] drops for the player.

[h3]Poll B: Enemy vs Run modifier ([i]25% chance[/i])[/h3] 
Viewers vote on an enemy [b]OR[/b] a new run modifier.
-> If an [b]Enemy wins the poll[/b], the winning enemy will spawn on [b]Floor 3[/b] in one of three forms ([i]1x Legendary enemy, 6x Elite enemies, or 20x Normal enemies[/i]).
-> If a [b]Modifier wins the poll[/b], the winning modifier is enabled for the [b]rest of the node[/b].

[h3]Enemies also appear with Viewer names[/h3]
[b]Chance per enemy type[/b]
-> [b]Normal[/b]: 1 in 300
-> [b]Elite[/b]: 1 in 40
-> [b]Legendary[/b]: 1 in 2

Viewers who are [b]subbed to your channel[/b] have [b]stronger stats[/b] and [b]drop 2 chests[/b] when defeated ([i]non-subs drop 1[/i]).
Finally, whenever a [b]viewer is defeated[/b] in game there is a small [b]in game notification[/b] as well as a [b]chat announcement[/b].

We’re eager to hear your feedback on this update! [url=https://discord.gg/Qx4WjqDZhA]Join us on Discord[/url] or over in the Steam forums and tell us what you think and to [b]share your ODINFALL streams[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/32ca599f21f9f86421f6dc0172860457a3a51df9.png[/img]

[h2]How to Access the Experimental Branch[/h2]
For more info on the [b]Experimental Branch[/b] and how to access it, check out the full rundown here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2154240/view/512953841353752650?snr=1_5_9_
[h1]Experimental Patch 0.5.7 Notes[/h1]
[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
• Twitch implementation – Let the audience decide loot and enemies!
• The pause screen now shows your current location and total kills.
• New animations for boss deaths
• New animations for cryo chamber pickups.
• Infinite areas scaling has been adjusted: enemies now gain +5 HP per floor 
• For elite enemies this is doubled, and for legendary enemies this is quadrupled
[h2]WEAPONS[/h2]
• [b]NEW: Cluster Launcher[/b]
• [b]NEW: Heavy Ballista[/b]

notes.title: Introducing the ODINFALL Experimental Branch & Patch 0.5.3!
notes.content:
Greetings, survivors!

We’re excited to introduce a new way for you to get an early look at upcoming changes - our [b]Experimental Branch[/b]! This system will allow us to test new updates with the community before rolling them into the main game, helping us fine-tune balance, fix potential issues, and make [b]ODINFALL[/b] the best it can be.

[h2]How the Experimental Branch Works[/h2]
Once a week, we’ll launch an [b]ODINFALL[/b] patch into the [b]Experimental Branch[/b]. Based on how it performs, we’ll then incorporate it into the [b]main branch[/b] later that week.

[h2]How to Access the Experimental Branch[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Open the game and go to Settings
[*] Navigate to Extra and select Experimental Branch
[*] You’ll receive a pop-up asking you to confirm your choice
[*] Restart your game and allow any updates to install
[*] Relaunch, and you’re in!
[/olist]
Keep in mind that the [b]Experimental Branch[/b] uses a separate save from the main game to prevent incompatibility issues. If you ever want to switch back, just return to the main branch - your original save will still be there waiting for you!

We’d love to hear your feedback on changes in the Experimental Branch, so be sure to share your thoughts with us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/jmhRWFTzzU]Discord[/url] or the Steam forums!

[h2]ODINFALL Patch 0.5.3[/h2]
[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
- Camera: Zoomout from last patch reduced from 80 to 50 pixels  
- Marketplace: Added selling altar  
- When a weapon challenge is completed the unlocked weapon drops  
- Random Loki Comments are now rarer  
- Act Panels now show a skull symbol for each unique mythic enemy currently enabled by the runmodifiers  
- Taking the hatch back to homebase after defeating a boss now shows that boss on the deathscreen instead of unknown  
- Stationary enemies no longer spawn on top of the blue exit hatch  
- In addition to the mouse, homebase tutorial popups can now be advanced using the keyboard  
- If an enemy limb kills you the owner of that limb is shown as the killer  
- Completing a weapon challenge now drops the weapon as a reward mid-run  
- The weapons on the first floor of the training grounds are now spawned by ammo category, and ordered by weapon tier  
- Fixed bug: Water droplets could spawn on open exit hatches in the sewer  
- Fixed bug: Pickups could sometimes fly away during cutscenes

[h3]WEAPONS[/h3]
[b]Added Thermal Rifle  
Added Laser Rifle  
Added Flak Cannon[/b]

[b]Minigun  [/b]
- Aim Spread reduced from 28 to 26 degrees
[b]Laser Minigun  [/b]
- Aim Spread reduced from 30 to 26 degrees
[b]Plasma Rifle  [/b]
- Projectile speed reduced from 8 to 6

- Laser damage increased from 6 to 8 (affects all laser weapons)  
- Plasma main target damage increased from 2 to 5 (affects all plasma weapons)  
- Plasma area damage increased from 9 to 10 (affects all plasma weapons)  
- Arrow damage increased from 10 to 12 (affects all crossbows)  
- Flechette damage increased from 3 to 4 (affects weapons like Homing Bolter and Homing Star)

[h3]MODS[/h3]
[b]Fire Rune  [/b]
- Burn Damage now scales exponentially.   
Old damage per tier: 2/4/6/8/10/12.  
New damage per tier: 2/4/8/16/32/64.

[h3]ENEMIES  [/h3]
[b]Snow Wolf  [/b]
- Updated art

Survivors!

[b]Patch 0.5.2 is now LIVE! [/b]

See 50% more of the battlefield for better awareness of enemies and projectiles!

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.5.1.5

[*]Gold: pickup range increased from 45 to 55
[*]Gold: can be picked up before it lands on the ground
[*]Gold: remains on ground 5 seconds longer
[*]Pickups: remaining duration paused while in cutscene
[*]Loot: Weapon tier can't be more than 2 lvls lower than the node's loot lvl.

[*]Number of enemies reduced slightly in most of act 1 (the desert). Particularly on floors with legendary bosses.

[*]Fixed bug: Loki called all your weapons terrible, no matter the weapon tier

[*]Fixed bug: Some Weapon Challenges completed even after their time limit had passed

[/list]

notes.title: ⚔️ ODINFALL – FAQ & Community Info ⚔️
notes.content:
Hey Vikings!

[b]ODINFALL[/b] has officially launched into [b]Early Access[/b], and we’ve been blown away by your incredible support so far. Whether you’re rampaging as a [b]Viking Moose[/b] or blasting enemies with [b]outrageous weapons[/b] thank you for being part of the apocalypse with us!

We’ve gathered some of the most frequently asked questions about [b]ODINFALL[/b] right here to help you dive in and make the most of your roguelite rampage. If you’ve got more questions, feel free to post them in the Steam discussions or [url=https://discord.com/invite/jmhRWFTzzU]join our Discord community[/url]!

[b][h1]⚔️ ODINFALL – FAQ ⚔️[/h1][/b]
Welcome to the apocalypse, Vikings! Here’s a quick roundup of the most frequently asked questions about ODINFALL.

[b]🕒 How long will ODINFALL be in Early Access?[/b]
[b]ODINFALL[/b] will be in [b]Early Access for approximately 6 months[/b], with regular content updates and improvements along the way.

[b]🎯 Will there be achievements?[/b]
Yes! [b]Achievements are coming in a future update[/b]. (before 1.0)

[b]🗺️ What's coming during Early Access and beyond?[/b]
We’ll be adding lots of new content and improvements, including:
 • New characters & abilities
 • Additional enemies
 • More weapons, perks & modifiers
 • Polishing, balancing & performance updates

[b]📅 Is there a roadmap?[/b]
Not currently, we are taking things one step at a time so while we may not create one, we will ensure to keep you all updated through our social channels! 

[b]🎮 Does ODINFALL support controllers?[/b]
Yes! ODINFALL fully supports controllers.

[b]🎮 Does ODINFALL support Steam Deck?[/b]
We currently are not steam deck verified, but it should work completely fine as we have full controller and 16:10 resolution support!

[b]👥 Is there co-op or multiplayer?[/b]
To focus on delivering the best core gameplay experience, we had to place Online Co-Op on hold for now. We'll be reassessing what needs to be done to get the Co-Op mode into a releasable state, and will be talking about this more in the coming weeks.

[b]🔁 Is there an infinite mode in ODINFALL?[/b]
Yes! After you defeat the Act Bosses for the second time and onwards, a special door will appear that leads to an infinite mode area with escalating difficulty. Good luck in there, warrior!

[b]🛠️ What engine is ODINFALL made in?[/b]
ODINFALL is developed using Game Maker Studio 2.

[b]💾 Will my progress carry over after Early Access?[/b]
YES! We will always avoid resetting anyone’s progression across updates.

[b]🐛 How do I give feedback or report bugs?[/b]
Please reply to the pinned steam discussion thread! - https://steamcommunity.com/app/2154240/discussions/0/601898665208999808/

[b]💻 What platforms is ODINFALL available on?[/b]
ODINFALL is currently available on PC via Steam.

[b]🎮 Will ODINFALL come to consoles?[/b]
We’d love to bring ODINFALL to consoles in the future, but for now our focus is on the PC version.

[b]📹 Can I stream or create content on ODINFALL?[/b]
Absolutely! We love seeing your content – stream it, make videos, and share clips! Tag us so we can see the chaos.

[b]🎵Is there a soundtrack I can listen to?[/b]
Yes! You can listen to the ODINFALL soundtrack here - https://davidsteinmarck.bandcamp.com/album/odinfall-extended-original-game-soundtrack

[b][h2]Leave a Review – It Helps a Lot![/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/6a2d9e1b2d02e373c4c662d5b2d139714e49f358.png[/img]

If you’re enjoying [b]ODINFALL[/b], please consider [b]leaving a Steam review[/b]. Your feedback means the world to us and helps immensely as a small indie team. It not only supports the game’s development but also helps other players discover the chaos!

Thank you so much for joining us on this wild, explosive, Viking-fueled adventure. We’ve got more mayhem coming your way soon — stay tuned!

– Ember Paw Games & Fireshine Games

notes.title: ⚔️ ODINFALL is OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey, Vikings!

The time has come - [b]ODINFALL[/b] [b]is officially OUT NOW in Early Access![/b]
Grab your weapons, prepare for chaos, and dive headfirst into the ultimate [b]Ragnarok Roguelite[/b] - where explosive combat, over-the-top weaponry, and apocalyptic mayhem collide.

[h2]👉 [b]Play now on Steam[/b][/h2] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154240/Odinfall/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/c8a08d8ffae18afd99f16b55643a8a04e8e8c1e0.gif[/img]

[h2]💥 Unleash the Mayhem[/h2]
ODINFALL throws you into a post-apocalyptic world where Norse mythology meets twin-stick shooter chaos. Fight your way through procedurally generated levels, pick from a wild roster of heroes, and craft your own path through a world on the brink of destruction. Expect [b]big explosions[/b], [b]big personalities[/b], and [b]even bigger weapons[/b].

Whether you’re blasting through hordes of enemies solo or experimenting with outrageous builds, there’s never a dull moment in [b]ODINFALL.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/b9c8e5710b19024cabd03bb5ba52c76265590f2c.gif[/img]

[h2]💰 Launch Price & Special Discount[/h2]
To celebrate launch, [b]ODINFALL is available at a special discounted price[/b] for a limited time!
[b]Launch Price:[/b] £10.99 / €12.99 / $12.99
[b]Launch Discount:[/b] 20% off until March 20th
Now’s the perfect time to grab your copy and dive into the action while the apocalypse is still hot!

[h2]🛠 What to Expect in Early Access[/h2]
ODINFALL will spend approximately [b]six months in Early Access[/b], during which we’ll be regularly rolling out new updates, content drops, gameplay improvements, and more based on [b]your feedback[/b].

Here’s a glimpse of what’s ahead:

- New characters and abilities
- Additional biomes and enemies
- More weapons, perks & chaotic modifiers
- Polishing, balancing, and performance tweaks

You’ll help shape the future of ODINFALL with every run, death, and explosion. 💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/75c534d9a8a7c8a3368ad520fcc52535f457e0db.gif[/img]

[h2]🧠 Why Early Access?[/h2]
We believe the best games are built with community input – and ODINFALL is no exception. Early Access allows us to work directly with you to refine mechanics, expand the game world, and make sure ODINFALL is the most fun, chaotic, and satisfying roguelite it can be.

Your feedback matters - so join the conversation, share your thoughts, and help us forge the future of the apocalypse.

[h3]📢 [b]Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/jmhRWFTzzU]Discord[/url] community[/b][/h3]

[h2]🔥 Ragnarok Has Begun[/h2]
Whether you're a Viking Moose, a cyber armed bezerker, or just here for the chaos - we’re so excited to finally welcome you into the apocalyptic world of ODINFALL.

Thank you so much for all your support so far. We’ll be back soon with more updates, reveals, and explosions. Until then…

See you in the apocalypse. ⚡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/4acac4f1189d0cba1034bac3c046bd9d77b558d4.gif[/img]

- Ember Paw Games & Fireshine Games

notes.title: ⚡ ODINFALL HAS A BRAND-NEW LOOK! ⚡
notes.content:
Hey, Vikings!

Ragnarok might be the end, but for [b]ODINFALL[/b], it’s just the beginning! We’ve been hard at work refining the game, and today, we’re excited to unveil a brand-new visual overhaul! From enhanced character designs to polished environments, [b]ODINFALL[/b] has never looked this good.

So, what’s changed? Let’s dive in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/36d4a1c04ca98c5d93e88d61427039a9aa93fdbf.gif[/img]

[h2]🔥 New & Improved Character Designs[/h2]
Our badass roster of apocalypse survivors has leveled up! Each character now features enhanced details, sharper animations, and an even more distinct personality. Whether you're wielding oversized weaponry or rampaging as a Viking Moose, you'll look cooler than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/677e0ec1617de09aed2a25d82e03e5e1005c2a2d.gif[/img]

[h2]🌍 Environments That Pack a Punch[/h2]
Destruction has never been this satisfying! We’ve upgraded our procedurally generated levels with improved lighting, richer details, and even more chaotic destruction. Expect bigger explosions, more reactive elements, and a world that truly feels alive (before you blow it up).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/9922e1b1ef0f11b0218b0f50d3a5df4c56ec2dbb.gif[/img]

[h2]⚔️ Combat That Feels Even Better[/h2]
It’s not just about looking good - it’s about feeling good. We’ve tweaked animations, improved VFX, and added extra punch to every attack, explosion, and robotic god takedown. Combat is now faster, smoother, and more satisfying than ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43865335/5f1be15739b209b3559a4380f1b86cd67f549a8b.gif[/img]

[h2]💥 More Mayhem, More Fun[/h2]
With all these changes, [b]ODINFALL[/b] is shaping up to be the most over-the-top, chaotic rogue-lite shooter yet. And we’re not done - there’s still more to come!
We can’t wait for you to dive into this new version, so let us know what you think! Drop your thoughts in the comments or join the conversation on [url=https://discord.com/invite/jmhRWFTzzU]Discord[/url].

Wishlist [b]ODINFALL[/b] now and get ready for the ultimate Viking apocalypse! ⚡
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154240/Odinfall/

To add a little variety, the second level of every node is now smaller and has fewer enemies than the first and third areas.

The second area of every node now has a 1 in 12 chance of being a Secret Cache! These areas have no enemies and 4 times the chests.
